description.value:
Heilig Bogen ("holy bow"). You may choose the Spirit Bow profile for your spirit weapon. Your bow needs no ammunition; you condense arrows out of ambient reishi. In an area with little or no ambient spiritual energy — a dead-magic zone, a sealed vault — your bow's damage die decreases by one step.

Blut [free-action] Frequency once per round. Choose Vene or Arterie. The choice lasts until the start of your next turn. You cannot have both — canon is explicit that they run on two different reishi systems.

  • Blut Vene (defensive) — resistance to physical damage equal to half your level (minimum 1).
  • Blut Arterie (offensive) — your Strikes with your spirit weapon ignore resistances to physical and spirit damage, and treat the target's cover as one step less.

Arterie grants no bonus to attack, damage, or DC. It is a resistance bypass, which is how a Quincy shoots through Hierro without touching Pathfinder's attack math.
